<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    ACTS Common Course - GEOL 1114

A survey of the earth's features and processes which include minerals, rocks, plate tectonics, geologic time, earthquakes, volcanoes, groundwater, development of landscapes, erosion, and climate change. Laboratory exercises will serve to support/enhance lecture topics.

Note: Duplicate credit for GEOL 1014 and GEOL 1004 will not be allowed.

Lecture three hours, laboratory three hours.  $40 laboratory fee. 

    
</section>
